description_en: Migrates an instance across physical nodes in response to an O&M event
description_zh: 实例发生运维事件后，对实例进行跨节点迁移操作
kebab_example: aliyun ens event-migrate-instance --event-id e-d71ff150945b9c02eb6ebc0016328468 --resource-id i-55qi8m11rr53c4i964md8a00l --ops-type immediate --region cn-hangzhou
name: EventMigrateInstance

parameters.help_en: The ID of the system event
parameters.name: event_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the O\&M task. Valid values:

`immediate`: Executes the task immediately.

`scheduled`: Executes the task at the specified time
parameters.help_zh:
运维任务类型，取值范围：

immediate：立即执行。
scheduled：预约执行
parameters.name: ops_type

parameters.help_en: The scheduled execution time. This must be a Unix timestamp in milliseconds. This parameter is required when `OpsType` is set to `scheduled`
parameters.help_zh:
预约执行时间，时间戳，单位毫秒。
当OpsType=scheduled时，此字段为必输
parameters.name: plan_time

parameters.help_en:
The data migration policy. Valid values:

`abandon`: Does not migrate data. This is the default value.

`force_transfer`: Forces data migration.

`try_transfer`: Attempts to migrate data
parameters.help_zh:
数据迁移策略，取值范围：
abandon：不迁移数据，默认值。
force_transfer：强制迁移数据。
try_transfer：尽量迁移数据
parameters.name: data_policy

parameters.help_en:
The instance password. This parameter is optional. If you do not specify a password, the system generates a random one.

The password must be 8 to 30 characters long and contain uppercase letters, lowercase letters, and digits.

Note: This parameter is not supported for scheduled execution
parameters.help_zh:
实例密码，非必输，不传时使用随机密码。

长度为 8 至 30 个字符，必须同时包含大小写英文字母、数字。

注意，预约执行时，不支持填写密码
parameters.name: password

schema.description_en: The data returned in the response
